config.world: Synthetic evaluators: metric G positive semidefinite of rank m or m-1 with eigenvalues log-uniform on [0.2, 5], ideal t standard normal, in dimensions m in {2, 3, 4}; batteries of n = m + offset consequences, standard normal (general position) or inside a random affine subspace of dimension m-1; choices are every strict preference of the semiorder a > b iff d(a) + eps < d(b), with eps = 0 (weak order) or eps set so that 20 percent of pairs are indifferent
config.estimator: max-margin semidefinite program of Theorem 3(a): maximise delta over G PSD and h in R^m with the Euclidean norm of (G, h) at most one, subject to Q(y_b) - Q(y_a) >= delta for every revealed strict preference a > b, Q(y) = y^T G y - 2 y^T h; metric reported at unit trace, ideal t = G^+ h
config.design_bound: at least m + 1 affinely independent consequences (offset >= 1 in general position); the subspace battery violates it at every n
config.bars: PREREG-G5.md Section 5; tolerances fixed from the pilot seed before sealing and applied to the run seed only
config.chance_reference: median error of 64 guesses drawn from the evaluator prior, per evaluator
config.ideal_readback: t = G^+ h with eigenvalues below rank_cut times the largest treated as kernel (the prior's eigenvalue ratio is at least 0.04, so no true direction is cut)
